title: Seoul to launch emergency response system for Czech nuclear project
caption:
South Korea is taking direct action to rescue a $17.5 billion nuclear deal in the Czech Republic after a contract breakdown with construction partners. The government is now fast-tracking a new tender process to keep the timeline for the Dukovany plant on track.

Source: En - Seoul to launch emergency response system for Czech nuclear project
